_README: ENTRY STAGE: what a pre-business student completes before admission to Rutgers Business School-New Brunswick (Prompt 08 B1).

Linked to each RBS program version. While a student is not VERIFIED as admitted (StudentAcademicEvidence kind 'admission', key 'rbs-nb-admission'), the plan includes these requirements and labels every business course 'after admission to RBS'. Completing them never grants admission.

The catalog names the four foundational ('eligibility') courses by TITLE only. Their course numbers, grade minimums, GPA and application timing are on myRBS / business.rutgers.edu pages that returned HTTP 403 to a plain GET, so each course list is UNKNOWN here. Course numbers that appear on archived pages only as PREREQUISITES are listed as review hints, never encoded.
